note: the verifier accepts any existing NodePath
the verifier accepts any powershell.exe basename
the verifier ignores the scheduled principal SID
the verifier derives the expected SID from spoofable environment variables
the verifier derives trusted PowerShell from a spoofable environment variable
the verifier trusts the expected SID without resolving the observed principal
multiple Node applications on PATH are treated as one executable
the verifier accepts duplicate wrapper parameters
from: Add-Check -Name "$($spec.Name) passes every parameter at most once" -Ok ($duplicates.Count -eq 0)
to: Add-Check -Name "$($spec.Name) passes every parameter at most once" -Ok ($true)

note: the verifier accepts Password although the activation definition requires S4U
